label: PF Backlog 52
title: Intake E2E (backend): live compile/approve/reject/route + HIL gate on promotion + start pipeline on modify
body: Approve/Reject/Route are NOT live (only in the unmounted core/intake_api.py); compile is automatic and irreversible; promote_conversation sets 'accepted' directly with NO HIL gate; modify_project creates a change package but does NOT start the pipeline. Fix: expose compile/approve/reject/route on the live backend; add a HIL approval gate before promotion (design sec 9.3); start the pipeline for modify_project; wire IntentRouter.create_project_from_idea (exists but never called). Refs: core/intent_router.py, core/backlog_link.py, docs/INTAKE-AND-BACKLOG-DESIGN.md:16,147.
